business_summary: Qingdao Paguld Intelligent Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells centralized lubrication systems and components in China and internationally. It offers lubrication systems and components, including progressive and intelligent lubrication systems; single-, dual-, and multi-line lubrication systems; lubrication systems for machine tools; single point lubrication pumps; industrial lubrication assembly; tools; and parts and accessories. The company also provides hydraulic systems and components, such as wind power hydraulic stations and oil lubrication; wind turbine hydraulic pitches; industrial hydraulics; piston accumulators and hydraulic cylinders; special valve blocks; threaded cartridge and industrial hydraulic valves; synchronous shunt motors; pressure sensors; and hydraulic accessories. In addition, it offers grease and consumable products, as well as wind power diaphragm coupling. Further, the company provides after-sales services. Its products are used in wind power equipment, construction machinery, rail transportation, mining equipment, tunnel boring equipment, agricultural machinery, port machinery, and other applications. Qingdao Paguld Intelligent Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
